missionPremise: The CSS for all four families already existed, fully written and token-only, in 30b_smartcity_design_system.html's own style block at lines 236-253 and 316-344. This row is a PORT of that known-good CSS into web/shell.css, not a design job, and it needs zero new tokens because --sc-atom and --sc-atom-wash already ship in all three theme blocks. Source: the read-only investigation _inbox/2026-08-18_g88_css_families_investigation.md, ratified into the approved WDLL. The reason the row exists at all: a Plan Review screen cannot be composed from kit components that do not exist, and without these four families a design agent would invent them, which is the exact failure the wrapper exists to prevent.
completionPredicate: web/shell.css defines cite, mx*, atomchip and finding/basisline/meter using only tokens that already ship; web/sc-kit.css is byte-unchanged by git blob hash; zero --sc-* declarations added to shell.css; zero font declarations below 12px; zero hex and zero rgb() outside comments; no markup added to web/index.html; npm test at least 185 pass and 0 fail; the CI check-run conclusion string is success; the five 30b-versus-30c divergences are each named with the value shipped. A stranger can evaluate every clause of this without me by running the commands in the verification block below.
scopeBasis: Four families and nothing else. CSS only, no markup: WDLL item 2 ships the vocabulary, item 9 ships the screens that use it, and merging those would have made the class gate meaningless for both. .prov.stale was deliberately NOT ported even though it sits three lines from .cite in the same spec block and is a live honesty defect on a shipped component, because the WDLL puts it explicitly out of scope and gives it its own row. roster-lens, the kit re-vendor, the denominator pin, the class-gate hardening and the cache contract are all separate WDLL items with their own owners.

amendment.ruling: Operator ruled 2026-08-19 on LOUD-1, the conflict this lane flagged and declined to decide: GRANT the carve-out before merge, do not hold at 12px.
amendment.what: Ship .atomchip and .atomchip .did at 30b own 10px values, and amend the product type gate so its named exception is REAL rather than notional. .basisline is NOT covered and stays at 12px, because 30b exception is the chip label only.
amendment.whyTheGateWasAmendedRatherThanBypassed: The gate was not wrong in principle, it went STALE. It hardcoded the floor as absolute and justified that in its own error string with the words the evidence chip, which does not exist in this product. That sentence was true when it was written and this card falsified it. Same shape as the G-87 finding, where a directory skip was correct when written and went stale when authored source moved into it.
amendment.lanePosture: This lane raised the conflict, declined to decide it, and shipped the conservative branch pending a ruling. The ruling reversed that branch. Recorded because a flagged-and-overturned call is a successful outcome under DEV_PROCESS 3.2, not a miss.
